description.zh: 创建频道的时间戳，支持查询最近30天的数据。使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒。
description.en: UNIX timestamp indicating the channel creation time. Supports querying data from the last 30 days. Expressed as a UNIX timestamp in seconds.

description.zh:
频道释放时间，使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒。参数为空表示获取当前时间。
> 如果传入的频道释放时间超过真实的释放时间，将返回从创建时间开始到真实释放时间之间的数据。
description.en:
Channel release time, represented as a UNIX timestamp in seconds. If this parameter is empty, the current time is used.
> If the provided channel release time exceeds the actual release time, data from the Creation Time to the actual release time is returned.

descriptions.zh:
### 使用说明
本接口用于查询频道概览数据。例如：您可以查询通信基本信息、指标趋势图等信息。
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### How-To  
This API is used to query channel overview data. For example, you can query basic communication information, Trend Indicators, and other information.  

### queries per second (QPS) Limit  
The QPS limit for this API is 10 queries per second per User. If the limit is exceeded, Rate Limiting will be applied to API Calls, which may Impact your business. Invoke the API appropriately.
